The feet are resting on a dark wooden surface, likely a deck or floorboards. A portion of a grey shoe or slipper is visible at the top right.

The separation between the big toe and the second toe on the right foot is ambiguous. The fabric seems to merge the toes slightly, lacking the distinct indentation usually seen when tight fabric separates digits. This suggests a minor structural definition failure.
The lines of the wooden planks in the background show slight waviness and inconsistency in perspective convergence, which is a common subtle artifact in AI-generated backgrounds, though not severe.
